query:
SELECT DISTINCT
                    a.id          AS "advisory_id!",
                    a.source      AS "source!",
                    a.cvss,
                    a.cvss_source,
                    a.exploited   AS "exploited!",
                    a.malware     AS "malware!"
                FROM advisory a
                JOIN advisory_affected f ON f.advisory_id = a.id
                WHERE f.ecosystem = $1
                  AND f.name = $2
                  AND (f.version IS NULL OR f.version = $3)
                ORDER BY a.id
